observations.title: Inspect a shulker without placing it
observations.player_action: Hover a shulker box and hold the configured tooltip key, documented as Left Alt.
observations.outcome: A client tooltip previews stored contents.
conditions: External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: Presentation/settings alone do not provide an inventory completion signal. Any quest would require a documented native action or explicit manual confirmation.

observations.title: Control the shulker preview
observations.player_action: Use the documented V toggle or inspect the experimental N contents-screen binding, unless remapped.
observations.outcome: The preview can be disabled or viewed through the experimental interface.
conditions: An experimental client contents screen must not be assumed to authorize server inventory changes.
